name: Acholi
region: Northern Uganda (Acholiland): Gulu, Kitgum, Pader, Amuru, Lamwo, Agago, Nwoya, Omoro
translator_note: Everyday Gulu Acholi in the voice of a young professional talking to a friend: 'Mak i UG' for Book, 'Kong igo cim' for Call ahead, 'cente me cim' for mobile money, 'ka ma cwinyi yom iye' (where your heart is at ease) for 'where you are comfortable'. Standard Acholi orthography with ŋ (poŋ, ŋeyo, lwoŋ). Earlier STR renderings are kept (Wot., Ribbe., Ter., Por, Lim, Riyo, Ceteci, Cak, Bino, Leb, An) except Rent, which the old dictionary rendered with 'Yeny' (to search); it is now 'Pango' (the common loan for renting) everywhere. Technical product words with no settled Acholi term (sandbox, plug-in, endpoint, API key, link, wallet, prototype) are carried as loans or short paraphrases and listed under uncertain.

strings.ops.p.every_town_on_the: Gaŋ ducu ma i map obedo yo ki i Kampala dok ceteci pa kene. Ka app me kabedo doŋ tye ka tic, UG miyo tuŋ me agiki bote, pe bwolo ni en tye kunnu.
